collection.title: Mercedes-Benz GLB Class 2019 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Mercedes-Benz GLB Class SUV 2019 Onwards requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 22" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Specific Fit Mercedes-Benz arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
